fields.title: Post / publication-profile record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Substack's own internal API JSON shape, plus `markdown` (this actor's own HTML-to-Markdown conversion of the post body). "post" mode and "archive" mode's per-post records carry a post object verbatim (title, body_html, publishedBylines, etc.). "archive" mode also emits one PUBLICATION_PROFILE record per publication (recordType discriminates), sourced from the publication homepage since no public unauthenticated publication-metadata API endpoint exists.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL/publication that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-api (post/archive JSON), S2-html (publication profile from window._preloads), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, invalid_post_url, auth_required).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: "archive" mode only -- PUBLICATION_PROFILE (once per publication) or POST (one per post).

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Post title/subtitle/byline/date header plus the post body converted to clean Markdown (Substack's own Subscribe/Share CTA boilerplate stripped). Ready to feed to an LLM/embedding pipeline as-is.

content_truncated.title: Content truncated
content_truncated.description: True when this post is paid-subscriber-only (`audience: "only_paid"`) -- the public API only returns Substack's own free-preview truncation of body_html/markdown for these, not the full text. This actor does not attempt to bypass that paywall.

wordcount.title: Word count
wordcount.description: Upstream's own word count for the full post.

publishedBylines.title: Bylines
publishedBylines.description: Author(s) -- list of byline objects, passed through as-is.

body_html.title: Body HTML
body_html.description: Raw upstream HTML body that `markdown` was converted from (truncated preview only when content_truncated is true).

custom_domain.title: Custom domain
custom_domain.description: PUBLICATION_PROFILE record -- the publication's own domain, if any.

hero_text.title: Tagline
hero_text.description: PUBLICATION_PROFILE record -- the publication's own tagline/description.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across post and publication-profile records.
